principles: Every retained record has date wording and numeric year bounds.
Broad centuries remain broad; no exact year is invented.
Settlement age, historic character and memorial/public-art layers remain separate.
Memorial dates may be unveiling, dedication, death, addition, relocation, installation or conservation and must be labelled.
Shared cemetery points are representative, not exact grave positions.
memorialLayerWarning: Research inventory only; not a substitute for field inspection.
